name: Sichuan Guoguang Agrochemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Guoguang Agrochemical Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, marketing, and distribution of agrochemical products and materials in China and internationally. It provides plant growth regulators, water-soluble fertilizers, fungicides, insecticides, bio-pesticide, and herbicides. The company also offers mepiquat chloride, forchlor fenuron, prohexadione-calcium, a-naphthylacetic acid, paclobutrazol, ethephon, chlormequat chloride, uniconazole, diethyl aminoethyl hexanoate, sodium benzylamino-purine, triacontanol, sodium salt, abscisic acid, indolebutyric acid, and thidiazuron, trinexapac-ethyl.
